title_en: Close to the center, 2+1 apartment for sale, perfect for investment!!
description_en: Close to the center, 2+1 apartment for sale, perfect for investment!!! The apartment is located on the 5th (top) floor of an existing building without an elevator and has a usable net area of ​​65.5 m2. The apartment is organized by the entrance hall, living room with kitchenette, two bedrooms, bathroom with window and balcony. The apartment has just been fully invested by the owner, starting from the plumbing system, flush toilet, electrical system, doors, parquet, double glazing, thermal glass, glazing, etc. The area in which it is located very close to Skenderbej square offers many facilities starting from the perfect location and for this reason it is a very good opportunity both for living and for investment since the rents are very high in that area. It has full mortgage documentation.
